sources.why: Quote-marketplace data, but the excerpt cuts off before any picks
Picks with capacity, power, warranty and median installed prices from marketplace data
Tesla's own Powerwall 3 spec sheet; covers one product only
Affiliate hub page about general cost and sizing
Review of FranklinWH only, with marketplace pricing
EcoFlow's own blog, so not neutral
Installer comparison from datasheets; discloses it is a Tesla installer

missing: Independent hands-on testing, such as measured usable capacity, real outage runtime, surge handling with an AC load, and long-term reliability, from a major reviewer or Consumer Reports. A neutral side-by-side of the whole-home batteries against the EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra is also missing.
why: Solar.com's marketplace data and the OC Solar comparison answer the question with real specs and prices. But no major reviewer tested these batteries, and the only authority source is Tesla's spec sheet for its own product. Everything else is untested affiliate roundups or brand content.
